_note: House destruction (docs/house-destruction.md Contract 5). carve.by_source: carve radius in metres by blast source, else splash radius * default_share; 0 = no carve. materials: resist (1.0 = the radius as is, 0 = never carved; read in 1/16 units), weight and strength (load before a cell crumbles) per cell material. support: passes of detach + load, span_cells (0 = off). fracture: Voronoi pieces of a fallen part. debris: the client's cosmetic debris; rubble fade|stay (/rubble overrides it for the round). ram: a vehicle that loses min_speed m/s (13.9 = 50 km/h) to a hollow house's wall in one tick rams it: its momentum (mass * speed lost) against momentum_per_cell * resist for every cell of the hole its cross-section needs (one sphere covering it plus margin_m, centred depth_m / 2 past the wall's face); more goes through, slowed by the cost; less leaves a dent of up to dent_max_m and stops.
